metadata.title: Formal Neighborhood Equivariant Cohomology and Kirwan Surjectivity at Singular Values
metadata.abstract: Let \(G\) be a compact Lie group acting Hamiltonianly on a symplectic manifold \(M\) with moment map \(\mu:M\to\g^*\). For a singular value \(a\) of \(\mu\), the symplectic quotient \(\mu^{-1}(a)/G\) is stratified and the classical Kirwan map is not defined. We introduce a \emph{formal neighborhood equivariant cohomology} \(\cH_G^*(a)\) using the slice-groupoid Cartan sheaf and the closed embedding \(\mu^{-1}(a)/G\hookrightarrow \mu^{-1}(U_a)/G\) for a \(G\)-invariant neighborhood \(U_a\) of \(a\). We define a formal Kirwan map \[ \kappa_{\mathrm{formal}}:H_G^*(M)\longrightarrow \cH_G^*(a). \] We prove that \(\kappa_{\mathrm{formal}}\) is surjective under a local \emph{equivariant homotopy retraction} condition on the slice level sets \[ C_x=\mu_x^{-1}(a|_{\g_x})\subset S_x, \] which is satisfied, for example, when \(a\) is a regular value of every slice moment map, or when \(a=0\) and \(C_x\) is a \(G_x\)-equivariant cone. The weakest condition we identify is the existence, for each \(x\in\mu^{-1}(a)\), of a local quasi-isomorphism \[ \Car(S_x,G_x)\simeq \cC^\bullet_{C_x} \] in a \(G_x\)-equivariant neighborhood of the orbit, without requiring a global tubular neighborhood. As an application we recover, in the formal framework, the even-degree surjectivity theorem of Delarue--Ramacher--Schmitt for \(S^1\)-actions and clarify why odd-degree surjectivity fails in general.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 奇异商上的上同调框架
analysis.workSummary: 对紧 Lie 群的 Hamilton 作用，作者用切片群胚的 Cartan 层及奇异能级商的闭嵌入定义形式邻域等变上同调，并构造形式 Kirwan 映射。在切片能级满足局部等变同伦回缩条件时证明满射；最弱表述为每个轨道附近存在指定 Cartan 复形与能级支撑复形的局部拟同构。
techniques: 切片群胚的 Cartan 层
局部等变同伦回缩和拟同构
analysis.breakthrough: 在不要求全局管状邻域的框架中处理奇异约化，恢复 S¹ 作用的偶数度满射结果并解释一般情形奇数度满射失败。
analysis.limitations: 满射有明确局部假设；不能写成所有奇异约化上的无条件 Kirwan 满射。切片矩映射正则值或 a=0 且能级为等变锥只是满足条件的例子，形式上同调不能直接替换为普通商空间上同调。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
